bug_fix_applied.issue: Override dialog not showing when 409 conflict returned
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Error handling in handleSave() was falling into catch block before checking res.status. The Emergent proxy was intercepting 409 responses.
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added defensive error handling to check for 409 in catch block error message and show override dialog. Also wrapped res.json() in try-catch to handle parsing failures gracefully.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All blocked dates features tested and working. The booking_type field is properly set to 'reservation' for regular bookings and 'blocked' for blocked dates. The frontend override dialog now works correctly when creating bookings that overlap with blocked dates. Total bookings increased to 66+ after test override bookings were created.
